input_fields.name: authorization_record
input_fields.description: User or task authorization with issuer, scope, validity, and restrictions.

input_fields.name: task_scope
input_fields.description: Requested application, documents, controls, outputs, and destructive-action boundaries.

result_fields.name: authorization_status
result_fields.description: One of applicable, expired, out_of_scope, or needs_manual_review.

result_fields.name: authorization_basis
result_fields.description: Matched scope, validity interval, and unresolved fields; never inferred consent.

procedure: Parse issuer, validity, application, artifact, and action scope without adding implied consent.
Compare each requested control with the explicit authorization; reuse an existing valid authorization instead of asking again.
Return authorization_status and authorization_basis, preserving missing or conflicting fields as unresolved.
Do not click, open, save, delete, or run anything as part of this operation.
rejection_rules: Reject missing, expired, revoked, or out-of-scope authorization; return needs_manual_review rather than assuming permission.
Reject a task scope that hides destructive actions behind a general run phrase.
Do not treat a prior unrelated session or controller default as authorization.
